primarySources.fact: A descendant left-button press produces WM_PARENTNOTIFY with low word WM_LBUTTONDOWN, sent to ancestors. For this notification the high word is undefined, not a child handle or unique press ID. WS_EX_NOPARENTNOTIFY can suppress delivery.
The high bit describes state at the time the function is called; a delivered down event can be processed after release.

State changes as the calling thread reads input messages from its own queue. The documentation does not guarantee that a sent descendant notification carries the child's input-queue state into the host thread.
Returns the creation time of the last queued message retrieved by GetMessage, not a unique physical press ID or guaranteed timestamp of a sent parent notification.
Device type can be IMDT_UNAVAILABLE while SendMessage runs, including system-generated messages; unavailable is not proof that the user gesture is fake.
IMO_HARDWARE also includes UIAccess injection; IMO_INJECTED includes SendInput by other applications. These categories do not uniquely identify a physical press.
The native event reports an actual HTML fullscreen-element state change, and Microsoft's sample connects it to host fullscreen entry/exit.
Requesting fullscreen normally consumes transient activation. The selected element enters the top layer; a non-root fullscreen element receives viewport-filling user-agent styling.

alternatives.getKeyState: Do not substitute it as permission evidence at WM_PARENTNOTIFY. Without establishing shared input-queue semantics, it merely replaces one timing assumption with another.
alternatives.inputSource: Do not require hardware-only origin or reject unavailable in the sent-notification path. Hardware can include UIAccess injection and unavailable includes legitimate system-generated sends. At most these could be fixed diagnostic categories under a separately approved budget; no new categories are needed by the preferred approach.
alternatives.htmlFullscreenEvent: This is a legitimate engine-mediated route and avoids arbitrary WebMessage authority. However SOOP currently places #player and #chatting_area as separately positioned siblings in one document. Allowing the original button to fullscreen #player could elevate only that element above the chat; fullscreen CSS may also override measured rectangles. Preserving both would require proving the original target or changing the requested element, or exiting DOM fullscreen after observing it with a new acknowledgement state machine. Those changes broaden layout/lifecycle behavior and are not recommended for this narrow repair. No claim is made that the official button's exact target has been observed in this run.
alternatives.globalOrProcessInputChanges: Do not use global hooks, browser child-thread subclassing, input polling, SetCapture/SetFocus, AllowHostInputProcessing, EnableMouseInPointer, synthetic mouse/key events, or a generic grace period.

preferredProposal.decision: Root explicitly approved using the exact owned controller's canonical WM_PARENTNOTIFY/WM_LBUTTONDOWN notification as native press evidence, rather than requiring the button still be down when that notification is processed. It is not an arbitrary JavaScript bridge or key-up authorization.
preferredProposal.threatBoundary: The source being guarded is remote page JavaScript. A page can send WebMessages but cannot manufacture host Win32 window-procedure notifications through the exposed bridge. Same-privilege native programs can send Win32 messages or inject input and are a different OS trust boundary; this change does not claim to defend against malicious same-user native applications. No general native command or hook is exposed to web content.
preferredProposal.canonicalPath: Accept only WM_PARENTNOTIFY whose low word is WM_LBUTTONDOWN on the one controller ParentWindow child already validated against the main HWND. Remove direct WM_LBUTTONDOWN as an alternate producer, avoiding two observers for the same press. Never use high-word child identity. Unexpected routes fail closed; do not restore dual producers or a page-only fallback just to pass QA.
preferredProposal.observer: At first canonical callback entry capture Instant::now(), immutable controller/root/pane association and the current nonblocking Binding. Require existing foreground, visible/enabled exact pane, WindowFromPoint hit, current player-only rectangle excluding chat/occlusions, and DPI guards. Preserve post-forwarding focus/context/binding checks. No physical current-state requirement, GetKeyState substitution, GetMessageTime age test or stamp dedup remains in this path.
preferredProposal.duplicateModel: Use a native per-controller atomic active-dispatch RAII guard and monotonically increasing local dispatch revision. The guard remains held across DefSubclassProc even if source binding is unavailable and never holds a session mutex. Nested/reentrant canonical down while an outer dispatch is active must not mint, replenish or overwrite a pending/consumed receipt. A per-dispatch committed marker prevents a second finish call from replenishing a consumed receipt; lifecycle clear never rearms the active guard. Only one receipt can be committed for that dispatch, and it is consumed once for the exact intended transition. Removing the direct producer eliminates the known direct/parent duplicate source. Win32 provides no global press ID here: non-reentrant arbitrary repeated native messages are not cryptographically proven to be one physical press and remain outside the remote-JavaScript threat boundary; do not describe the internal revision as a physical ID.
preferredProposal.deadline: At most500ms from first native observation using monotonic Instant. It is an expiry on native evidence, not a 500ms permission window following any page message. No native event means no receipt; delayed page requests, consumed receipts and wrong binding remain denied. Receipt creation time is not backdated using an unrelated host queue timestamp.
preferredProposal.unchangedAuthorization: Keep exact page origin/path/video identity, native label, message UUID, document epoch, current presenter, optional exact fullscreen Grant, intended enter/exit boolean, context/focus/hit/DPI, generation invalidation and once-only consumption. Entry rechecks its captured binding in coordinator validity; exit releases its captured Grant only. No held/missing/expired fallback. Keep geometry, original UI and chat untouched.
preferredProposal.lifecycle: Clear receipt/generation on focus loss, hidden viewport, navigation/epoch, presenter/grant transition, close/destruction. Keep the active-dispatch guard safe across nested invalidation/destruction and never hold a session lock across DefSubclassProc. Forward original native messages unchanged.
preferredProposal.diagnostics: Keep current32 canonical attempts/64 rows and static reason values. Update/remove stale queue/current-button reason wording truthfully; do not add raw messages, coordinates, times, HWNDs, aliases, URLs, nonces, credentials or arbitrary strings.
